title: lycopodiella glaucescens
intro: Lycopodiella glaucescens, commonly known as the Glaucous Spike-moss, is a species of spikemoss in the family Lycopodiaceae. This plant is a type of non-vascular, terrestrial plant that belongs to the group of lycopodiophytes, which are vascular-free plants. Research has shown that Lycopodiella glaucescens possesses various health benefits, including its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
